description_en: Lists DDoS attack events for a specified asset with a public IP address
description_zh: 查询单个公网IP资产上发生的DDoS攻击事件的详情列表
kebab_example: aliyun antiddos-public describe-ddos-event-list --ddos-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-type ecs --instance-id i-bp10bclrt56fblts0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDdosEventList

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the asset that is assigned a public IP address.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html to query all region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/353250.html查询所有地域ID
parameters.name: ddos_region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the asset that is assigned a public IP address. Valid values:

ecs: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance.

slb: a Server Load Balancer (SLB) instance.

eip: an elastic IP address (EIP) instance.

ipv6: an IPv6 Gateway instance.

swas: a simple application server instance.

waf: a dedicated Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

ga_basic: a Global Accelerator instance
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例类型。取值：

ecs：表示云服务器ECS实例。
slb：表示负载均衡SLB实例。
eip：表示弹性公网IP实例。
ipv6：表示IPv6网关公网实例。
swas：表示轻量服务器公网实例。
waf：表示Web应用防火墙独享实例。
ga_basic：表示全球加速公网实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the instance for the asset that is assigned a public IP address.

Call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html to query the IDs of the ECS, SLB, and EIP instances that belong to your Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的公网IP资产的实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/354191.html查询当前阿里云账号拥有的ECS、SLB、EIP实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return for a paged query. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码。默认值为1
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The number of attack events to return on each page for a paged query. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含攻击事件的数量。默认值为10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the asset that is assigned a public IP address
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的公网IP资产的IP地址
parameters.name: internet_ip

parameters.help_en: The number of days to query backwards from the current time. Default value: 7
parameters.help_zh: 指定从当前时间向前查询的天数。默认值为7天
parameters.name: query_days

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. Alibaba Cloud generates a unique ID for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Total.description_en: The total number of DDoS attack events found
Total.description_zh: 查询到的DDoS攻击事件的总数量
